segments.snp1.1:1.1: Yo [yo ve (syā.)] uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃva osadhehi [osadhebhi (ka.)];
segments.snp1.1:1.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ [jiṇṇamiva tacaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), jiṇṇamivā tacaṃ (?)] purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:2.1: Yo rāgamudacchidā asesaṃ, bhisapupphaṃva saroruhaṃ [sareruhaṃ (ka.)] vigayha;
segments.snp1.1:2.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ, purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:3.1: Yo taṇhamudacchidā asesaṃ, saritaṃ sīghasaraṃ visosayitvā;
segments.snp1.1:3.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:4.1: Yo mānamudabbadhī asesaṃ, naḷasetuṃva sudubbalaṃ mahogho;
segments.snp1.1:4.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:5.1: Yo nājjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ, vicinaṃ pupphamiva [pupphamiva (bahūsu)] udumbaresu;
segments.snp1.1:5.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:6.1: Yassantarato na santi kopā, itibhavābhavatañca [itibbhavābhavatañca (ka.)] vītivatto;
segments.snp1.1:6.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:7.1: Yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā, ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā;
segments.snp1.1:7.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:8.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ accagamā imaṃ papañcaṃ;
segments.snp1.1:8.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:9.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ vitathamidanti ñatvā [utvā (syā. pī. ka.)] loke;
segments.snp1.1:9.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:10.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ vitathamidanti vītalobho;
segments.snp1.1:10.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:11.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ vitathamidanti vītarāgo;
segments.snp1.1:11.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:12.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ vitathamidanti vītadoso;
segments.snp1.1:12.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:13.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ vitathamidanti vītamoho;
segments.snp1.1:13.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:14.1: Yassānusayā na santi keci, mūlā ca akusalā samūhatāse;
segments.snp1.1:14.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:15.1: Yassa darathajā na santi keci, oraṃ āgamanāya paccayāse;
segments.snp1.1:15.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:16.1: Yassa vanathajā na santi keci, vinibandhāya bhavāya hetukappā;
segments.snp1.1:16.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.snp1.1:17.1: Yo nīvaraṇe pahāya pañca, anigho tiṇṇakathaṃkatho visallo;
segments.snp1.1:17.3: So bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇamivattacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
